inherited.M01: No Lipper-specific user training action is introduced; training examples follow the OuluVS2 recording protocol.
inherited.M02: Paired video and speech-target training follows the Vid2Speech lineage (Ephrat and Peleg, 2017); no auxiliary phoneme or CTC supervision is introduced.
inherited.M03: Speaker-dependent training with two training phrases and one test phrase per speaker; speaker-independent with two held-out speakers; no seeds or validation set (Sec. Speech-Reconstruction Model)
inherited.M04: Silent face-video presentation follows the Vid2Speech inference path; no distinct user operation is introduced, and the delay claim is treated under M13.
inherited.M07: The direct video-to-speech path uses no external language model or lexicon, consistent with Vid2Speech (Ephrat and Peleg, 2017); the fixed ten-class text classifier is separate and does not guide synthesis.
inherited.M08: Waveform output follows the Vid2Speech lineage (Ephrat and Peleg, 2017); the separate ten-class text output is ancillary.
inherited.M09: No confirmation or commit interface is introduced; this remains outside the one-pass Vid2Speech-style waveform-generation path.
inherited.M10: No correction or re-entry loop is introduced; this remains outside the one-pass Vid2Speech-style waveform-generation path.
inherited.M11: PESQ against the recorded OuluVS2 audio of the same utterance (pairing not spelled out, Sec. Evaluation Metric); predecessor lineage arxiv-1807.00619
inherited.M13: Offline laboratory recordings; a 0.169 s delay is reported without hardware or timing boundaries (Table 11); critique carried in 'claims outrun the evidence', not a topic audit

topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that decode speech (text or a speech waveform) from video of the talking face or lips, with the ledger recording an optical camera and a lip-reading, visual speech recognition or video-to-speech task, and count from the full text (reference list removed) whether the study feeds more than one simultaneous camera view (multi-view input), addresses non-frontal or profile poses, or uses the multi-view OuluVS2 corpus. Boundary: audio-visual speech recognition counts when the visual stream is decoded; talking-head generation, face recognition and biometric-only studies are excluded; a study counts under every design its text names (upper bound, related-work mentions included); versions counted once.
topics.pattern: (?s)^(?=.*modalities=optical_camera)(?=.*(lip ?read|lipread|speech ?read|visual speech recognition|\bVSR\b|lip-to-speech|lip to speech|video-to-speech|video to speech|speech reconstruction|task_family=speech_reconstruction))

topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that synthesize a speech waveform from video of the talking face or lips (silent or with audio muted at test) and report the acoustic representation and how it is turned into a waveform. Boundary: exclude audio-visual speech enhancement or separation that takes noisy audio at test, talking-head generation (speech to video), text-only lip reading and video-to-text-to-TTS pipelines; count versions of one study once.
topics.pattern: (?s)^(?=.*(modalities=optical_camera|lip video|mouth video|face video|silent video|lip movements))(?=.*(task_family=speech_reconstruction|lip-to-speech|lip to speech|video-to-speech|video to speech|speech reconstruction from|synthesi[sz]ed speech|vocoder))

topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that synthesize a speech waveform from talking-face or lip video (the population of the M06 video-to-speech-synthesis table) and compare how the synthesized speech is evaluated: human listener or opinion tests, ASR word error on the synthesized speech, and tests on speakers unseen in training. Boundary: audio-visual enhancement with noisy audio at test, talking-head generation, text-only lip reading and video-to-text-to-TTS pipelines excluded; a study counts under every protocol its full text names (upper bound, related-work mentions included); versions counted once.
